Where Do I Take My Household
Drop off HHW (maximum 50L or 25 units/day) at these Community Recycling Centres (CRC)
1. Bring needles in a sealed container (i.e. 2 litre pop bottle). We will not handle loose needles.
2. If it took a friend to load it, bring a friend to unload it. Staff do not unload vehicles.
3. 50L or 25 units of HHW accepted per day at Bewdley and Brighton CRCs.
4. We do not empty gasoline, oil, or antifreeze. The container you bring it in will not be returned to you.
Oil, gasoline and antifreeze need to be in pails less than 20L (5 gallons). We do not accept drums.
5. Hazardous Waste is only accepted from Northumberland County residents.
Drop off E-Waste* for no charge at any CRC year-round, every day they are open.
Where Do I Buy Garbage Tags?
Garbage tags sell for $4.25* each, however, some vendors charge an additional 10% handling fee. The maximum
charge for bags tags should not exceed $4.68.  **Online purchases include a handling fee to cover mailing costs.
